knowledge_chunks.content: Mana Inti Ruchulu is owned by Pavani. Contact numbers: 9885993213 and 9948295369. Address: Pasuvullanka, Ipolavaram Mandal, Konaseema District, Andhra Pradesh, PIN 533220. Tagline: 'Homemade with Love • Authentic Andhra Taste'. All products are 100% authentic, homemade Andhra delicacies with no artificial preservatives.

Mana Inti Ruchulu accepts orders across India (All-India Delivery). Orders can be placed online through the catalogue. Delivery charges are calculated directly by the business after receiving the order and PIN code details. Once dispatched, customers receive courier name, tracking number, and tracking URL via the Track Order page.

- Veg Pickles: 6 to 9 months when stored in an airtight jar using a clean, dry spoon.
- Non-Veg Pickles: 3 to 6 months (refrigeration recommended for longer freshness).
- Podis / Powders: 4 to 6 months.
- Pindi Vantalu & Snacks: 30 to 45 days.
- Healthy Foods: 3 to 6 months.

Payment Options: Payment is flexible via UPI (PhonePe/GPay/Paytm) or Bank Transfer or Cash on Delivery where available. Order Tracking: Customers can track their order on the Track Your Order page using their Order ID (format: MIR-YYYYMMDD-XXXX) and Mobile Number.
